# Black Systems

> AI automation agency that designs, builds, and maintains automation systems for growing businesses. We eliminate manual work, generate leads, and scale operations without adding headcount.

## Company
- Founder: Márton Csizmazia
- Location: Budapest, Hungary
- Contact: marton@blacksystems.ai
- Website: https://blacksystems.ai
- Serving: UK and EU businesses, 5 to 100 people

## Services
- AI Automation: End-to-end workflow automation. Lead handling, onboarding, reporting, follow-ups, data entry.
- AI Strategy: Operations mapping, identifying highest-impact automation opportunities, clear roadmap.
- Automation Partner: Ongoing maintenance, improvement, and expansion of automation systems.

## Target clients
Marketing agencies, service businesses, and scale-ups across the UK and EU who spend too much time on manual, repetitive work.

## Positioning
Custom-built automation systems, not templates or off-the-shelf tools. Built by a software engineer, not a consultant. Systems run 24/7 without manual intervention. First automation live within 2 weeks. Average lead response time 60 seconds.
